validation_use: The validation split was already used by the frozen residual-ranker gate. These results are descriptive mechanism evidence only; they are not an independent gate, a tuning signal, or a new held-out evaluation.
claim_boundary: Oracle best-30 reranking is a post-hoc shortlist ceiling on baseline-generated banks. It does not establish an implementable scorer, treatment CEM behavior, planner deployment, closed-loop success, or speedup.
